shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "git status --short && find . -maxdepth 4 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort && for f in package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js'; do echo \"FILE:"'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json 2>/dev/null || true && sed -n '1,240p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|get(ServerSide|Static|Initial)Props|getStaticPaths|NextApi|pages/|\\.js'|\\.js\\\"\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.next/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' .gitignore && test -d node_modules && echo node_modules-present || echo no-node_modules && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\" 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n \"export type Metadata|interface ErrorProps|global-error\" node_modules/next/types node_modules/next/dist --glob '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/next/dist/server/route-modules/app-route/helpers/auto-implement-methods.js && sed -n '1,180p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,180p' app/error.tsx && sed -n '1,140p' app/not-found.tsx && sed -n '1,160p' components/AppProvider.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && find app -type f -maxdepth 6 -print | sort && rg -n \"next/(head|router|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApi(Request|Response)\" app components styles pages --glob '*.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}'"
/bin/bash -lc 'test ! -d pages && echo '"'pages directory removed' || find pages -print; npx next typegen && npx tsc --noEmit"

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json styles/globals.css components/AppProvider.js components/AppProvider.tsx app && test ! -e pages && echo '"'verified: pages absent' && rg -n \"next/(head|router|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApi(Request|Response)|pages/\" app components styles tsconfig.json next.config.ts package.json || true"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -o pipefail
for url in / /blog /blog/1 /this-route-does-not-exist /api/posts /api/posts/7; do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/codex-body -w '"'%{http_code}' \"http://localhost:3100"'${url}")
  title=$(rg -o '"'<title>["'^<]*'"' /tmp/codex-body | head -n 1 || true)
  printf '%-30s %s %s\\n' \""'$url" "$code" "$title"
done
curl -sS -i -X POST http://localhost:3100/api/posts -H '"'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"Typed route\",\"content\":\"Works\"}' | sed -n '1,12p'
curl -sS -i -X PATCH http://localhost:3100/api/posts | sed -n '1,12p'
curl -sS -i -X PUT http://localhost:3100/api/posts/7 -H 'content-type: application/json' --data '{\"title\":\"Updated\"}' | sed -n '1,12p'
curl -sS -i -X DELETE http://localhost:3100/api/posts/7 | sed -n '1,12p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' next-env.d.ts && sed -n '1,120p' tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,80p' .gitignore && du -sh .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "rm -r /workspace/.next
rm /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
git status --short
find . -maxdepth 5 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './__agent_eval__/*' -print | sort
git diff --check"

/bin/bash -lc 'rm -r /workspace/.next
rm /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
test ! -e /workspace/pages && echo '"'pages directory: absent'
git diff --check
git status --short
rg -n \"next/(head|router|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApi(Request|Response)\" app components || true"
